rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded day-5 blastocyst with thinning zona, identifiable ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with 3AA; appropriately notes limits of a single static image, though some features are inferred rather than directly verifiable.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, endometrial thickness, prior IVF outcomes, semen parameters, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, linking favorable and cautionary factors to prognosis; minor issue is that the implantation/live birth estimates may be somewhat conservative for a 24-year-old with a 3AA embryo.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines, including SET for a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst and attention to hydrosalpinx/luteal support; minor deviations include speculative protocol commentary and broad discussion of PGT-A.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, uterine/tubal evaluation, luteal support, follow-up, and future cycle review, with appropriate nuance if transfer fails.
